G2410763.description: São Tomé is the capital and largest city of the Central African island country of São Tomé and Príncipe. Its name is Portuguese for "Saint Thomas".

G2410805.description: Santo António (Portuguese for Saint Anthony), also known as Santo António do Príncipe, is the main settlement of the island of Príncipe in São Tomé and Príncipe. It lies on the north east coast.

G2410809.description: Santo Amaro is a town in São Tomé and Príncipe. It is located in Lobata District, northern São Tomé Island.

G2410860.description: Ribeira Afonso is a village on the eastern coast of São Tomé Island in São Tomé and Príncipe. Its population is 1,621 (2008 est.).

G2410972.description: Neves is a town on the north west coast of São Tomé Island in São Tomé and Príncipe. It is the seat of the Lembá District.

G2411049.description: Lemos is a village on São Tomé Island in the nation of São Tomé and Príncipe. Its population is 1,136 (2012 census).

G2411155.description: São João dos Angolares is a small town on the east coast of São Tomé Island in São Tomé and Príncipe. It is the seat of Caué District.

G2411244.description: Bombom is a town in the north-eastern part of São Tomé Island in São Tomé and Príncipe. Its population is 498 (2012 census).

G2411305.description: Água Izé is a village on São Tomé Island. Its population is 1,255 (2012 census).

G2411306.description: Porto Alegre (Portuguese for "Happy Port") is a village in Caué District on São Tomé Island in São Tomé and Príncipe. Its population is 795 (2012 census).
